officialSource.review: All rows, race scores, codes, exclusions, board numbers and totals visually checked against the official rendered HTML table. No official final-results PDF located.

sheet.scheduleNotes: Final results. Official digital scorecard visually checked. PDF corroboration unavailable. Senior Men: two long-distance race scores at half points under Local SI Addendum 1.1(a), with no discard. Outside Singapore national rankings.
